title: In an abstract ring, any element times zero is zero
statement: For any ring record R (an abstract carrier, additive commutative group, multiplication, distributive laws) and any a of R's carrier, mul a zero = zero -- derived from the additive-group and distributive axioms alone, without ever using a multiplicative identity.

formal.statement: theorem Alg.ringMulZero : ((x0 : Alg.Ring) -> ((x1 : Alg.Ring.carrier x0) -> Eq.{1} (Alg.Ring.carrier x0) (Alg.Ring.mul x0 x1 (Alg.Ring.zero x0)) (Alg.Ring.zero x0)))

evidence.supports: Alg.ringMulZero admits through the trusted kernel gate and, applied at TWO CONCRETE Alg.Ring instances (Int.ring, Rat.ring, each built independently of the Alg.CommRing/Alg.Field instances from the same underlying Int.*/Rat.* lemma constants -- no inheritance) closed over a symbolic a, type-checks to a term def_eq to `mul a zero = zero` with mul/zero iota-reduced through each instance's own selectors.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib -- ring_mul_zero_applies_at_int_and_rat_instances --nocapture --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out"| grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pattern is anchored on cargo's own pass/fail summary line with BOTH counts pinned ('1 passed; 0 failed'), so a wrong reduced type (a def_eq assertion failure) or a kernel refusal of the instantiation both make the test panic and the pattern stop matching.

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel build_rat_prelude, lane structures-1, ADR-1578 -- proved once over the abstract Alg.Ring record from the additive-group and distributive axioms alone, and instantiated at two independently-built carriers.

notes: The proof never invokes a multiplicative identity field (Alg.Ring.mulOneL/mulOneR are unused) -- only distribL, addZero, addComm, negAdd and addAssoc, matching the task's 'from the ring axioms alone'. Does not extend to a Semiring (no additive inverse, so the cancellation step this proof uses is unavailable) -- Alg.Semiring has no negAdd field and this theorem is not stated over it.
